excerpt.zh: 我们拥有了一艘£colony_ship£殖民船，也发现了至少一处可以建造永久系外据点的星球。没理由犹豫了，快建立我们的第一个£colony£殖民地吧！
excerpt.en: We have a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship, and we have found at least one suitable candidate for a permanent extrasolar outpost. I see no reason to delay further - let's establish our first £colony£ Colony!
